title: Last name first
description:
Write `std::string lastNameFirst(std::string_view fullName)` that turns `"Ada Lovelace"` into `"Lovelace, Ada"`.

The name always has exactly one space. Find it with `find(' ')`, then cut the name into two pieces with `substr`.

| Call | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `s.find(' ')` | index of the first space |
| `s.substr(0, n)` | the first `n` characters |
| `s.substr(n)` | everything from index `n` to the end |
hints: If the space is at index `space`, the first name is `substr(0, space)` and the last name starts one character later: `substr(space + 1)`.
`substr` on a `std::string_view` gives another view. Turn each piece into a `std::string` so that you can join them with `+`.
